positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Modernized deployment infrastructure by migrating from Capistrano to containerized environments orchestrated with Kubernetes, improving scalability, reliability, and deployment consistency.
Upgraded core application stack from Ruby on Rails 5.0 to 7.2, enabling access to modern frameworks, security patches, and performance enhancements.
Championed a test-first development culture, driving adoption of automated testing within CI/CD pipelines and significantly reducing production defects.
Provided critical support and enhancements for a legacy Rails 2.3.18 application, ensuring business continuity during modernization initiatives.
Diagnosed and resolved complex database performance issues by identifying and implementing index optimizations, reducing query times, and improving system responsiveness.
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby · Ruby on Rails · Test Driven Development · Agile Methodologies · Software Development · Back-End Web Development · Coding Standards · Code Review · Coaching

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Upstart delivered lower-interest personal loans through AI-augmented underwriting. I helped decompose their monolith and enable scalability. I enabled $10,000/mo savings in AWS costs through optimizing CI tests. I coordinated and led 5 LATAM contractors in service of core re-platforming KPI to extract and scale the core business logic.
positions.insights: Skills: Test Automation · Microservices · Ruby · PostgreSQL · REST APIs · Ruby on Rails · Back-End Web Development · Performance Tuning · Code Review · Coding Standards

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: GovCIO helps government agencies run faster and easier. I delivered 40% improvement in va.gov responsiveness by reducing database load by ~85% through cache strategy optimization. I was the sole backend engineer on the team responsible for Facilities API, which was responsible for 70% of site traffic with the mandate to improve veteran provider search experience.
positions.insights: Skills: PostgreSQL · REST APIs · Back-End Web Development · Performance Tuning · Code Review · Coding Standards

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Rapid7 offers various security solutions and services. I reduced the CI test run time from 20 hours to 45 minutes through non-trivial parallelization. I was promoted to Lead Software Engineer on the Quality Engineering team in a Player-Coach role.
positions.insights: Skills: PostgreSQL · REST APIs · Back-End Web Development · Performance Tuning · Code Review · Coding Standards

Ruby Scripts to automate system administrator functions.
